brief: A planter tower for a patio: one planter three storeys tall in the middle, ringed by six planters two storeys tall, with a crescent of five one-storey planters hugging the front of the ring on the side nearest the default view, so the whole build steps up one, two and three storeys away from the viewer. All bins radial-drain. Behind the ring, three one-storey cells with covers make a potting shelf: one small nursery pot on each cover, each filled with soil and planted with a seedling. Fill every planter with soil and plant it: a patio tomato in the middle; butterhead lettuce, oakleaf lettuce, parsley, basil, chives and a marigold around the ring; nasturtium, alyssum, strawberry, thyme and oregano along the crescent. Use look to check that every plant is visible from the default view.

requirements.evidence: Default look (az45,polar62) showed 13/15 plant props including all 12 planter plants; the two rear shelf seedlings (prop:3 thyme seedling, and prop:5 was intermittently occluded) are hidden behind the 2-3 storey tower from that exact angle. Top-down look (polar10) and az10/az80 views confirmed all 15 plants are present and visible from other angles; the shelf is intentionally at the back. check_build is ok with meshClash clear and no prop warnings.

finish.summary: Built a stepped patio planter tower: 3-storey centre with patio tomato, 6 two-storey ring planters (both lettuces, parsley, basil, chives, marigold), 5 one-storey front crescent planters (nasturtium, alyssum, strawberry, thyme, oregano) on the +x/+z side facing the default view, all in radial-drain bins filled with soil. Behind the ring (-x side) a 3-cell covered potting shelf holds three XS nursery pots, each soiled and planted with a seedling (basil, parsley, thyme). House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints); check_build passes with meshClash clear. Caveats: planter bins are standard-depth radial bins fitted at the top of each stepped column (multi-storey-deep bins were refused by the configurator), and from the exact default camera two rear shelf seedlings are occluded by the tower itself, though all plants are visible top-down and from neighbouring angles.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, drained, radial holes
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
